correctness.rationale: For each epsilon in {0,1}^5 the square classes d_i(t-i) are independent over algebraic closure by valuations at their distinct simple zeros. The extension has degree 32 and six tame index-two branch places; Riemann-Hurwitz gives genus 17. Four diagonal quadrics define the smooth complete intersection. Character-idempotent decomposition yields fifteen elliptic quotients from 3/4-element subsets and one genus-two quotient, and no genus from smaller characters. Independent F7 square-root counts give elliptic trace histogram 9 zero, 4 minus four, 2 plus four. Genus-two quotient counts 8 over F7, 46 over F49 imply L=1-2T²+49T⁴, one each trace plus/minus four. All 32 coefficient twists were independently enumerated over F7 with point histogram {0:18,16:12,32:2}; their quotient traces give m. Direct fresh F49 extension-field fiber enumeration found exactly 160 points for every twist; this agrees with eigenvalue-squared trace. The isogeny decomposition has 2-power kernel, prime to seven, so it induces an isomorphism of 7-divisible groups; nine trace-zero supersingular elliptic factors give a-number 9 and eight ordinary factors give p-rank 8, with specified slopes. No claim that 32 labels are distinct abstract isomorphism classes.

final_claim: For the 32 coefficient-marked square-class descents of the genus-17 type-five Humbert–Edge (Z/2)^5 cover of P1 over F7 branched at 0,1,2,3,4,infinity, the zeta numerators take precisely three forms (1+7T²)^9 (1-4T+7T²)^m (1+4T+7T²)^(8-m) with (m,multiplicity)=(1,2),(3,12),(5,18); F7 point spectrum 32:2,16:12,0:18, F49 count always 160, p-rank eight, a-number nine.
